svg.aria-label: Left: on the banana-shaped Rosenbrock valley gradient descent with backtracking crawls along the valley floor and has not arrived after 5000 steps, while BFGS and Newton reach the minimum in a few dozen steps. Right: loss per iteration on a log scale, with gradient descent nearly flat and the curvature methods dropping to machine precision
